article.title: How Specializing the Vocabulary of SLMs Can Cut Inference Cost by 77% in Real Applications

harvestedTerms.summary: A Hugging Face blog post by Dharma-AI previewing the VocabX paper: a method for specializing small language model tokenizers to a single domain by replacing the base vocabulary with a domain-specific one optimised for inference *cost* rather than token frequency, achieving a reported 77% inference cost reduction on a Portuguese essay-grading system. The piece provides a detailed technical walkthrough of prefill vs decode economics, LM-head matrix overhead, and why existing vocabulary adaptation methods (FVT, MWT, in-place BPE) fall short.

mustReadFlagged.reason: A technically rigorous walkthrough of an under-discussed optimisation lever — tokenizer vocabulary — that can dramatically reduce inference cost for domain-specialised small models. Worth a look if you're tracking SLM deployment economics or the emerging vocabulary-specialisation literature.

article.title: The Hidden Upside of Tech Challenges

harvestedTerms.summary: MIT Sloan Management Review piece on technostress research, distinguishing technology hindrances (draining, demotivating) from technology challenges (stimulating, growth-oriented). Primarily a workplace psychology / management article with light AI relevance — touches on generative AI as a source of technostress and employee anxiety about replacement/surveillance, but the core argument is about stress typology and managerial reframing.

article.title: Netflix Earnings, Business or Franchise, Disney’s Deal

The post is a short link blog entry with minimal AI terminology content — it's primarily about game design and open-source community dynamics.
